# Exclusive Remodeling

> Kitchen, bath & home remodeling based in Spring, Texas. From a showroom on I-45, Amine and his crew remodel kitchens, baths, stairs and patios across Spring and The Woodlands. Reviewers say the team protects the house, cleans up daily and finishes on budget.

## Services
- Kitchen remodeling: Cabinets, quartz counters, islands and backsplashes, with an itemized estimate up front.
- Bathroom & master bath: Master suites and kids' baths rebuilt with new vanities, tubs and tile.
- Walk-in showers: Frameless glass, mosaic tile walls and lit niches.
- Stairs, closets & feature walls: Rebuilt staircases and railings, custom closets and paneled accent walls.
- Flooring & painting: New floors and whole-house repaints, often as part of a bigger remodel.
- Patios & outdoor kitchens: Patio covers, outdoor living rooms and built-in outdoor kitchens.

## About
Exclusive Remodeling works out of a showroom at 26103 I-45 in Spring and has over 10 years of experience. Owner Amine is the person most reviewers name: easy to talk to, quick to respond and closely involved from the first estimate to the final walkthrough. The crew covers rooms in plastic and puts up dust barriers so families can live at home during the work, then cleans up every day. Jobs come with a homeowner's warranty, and the company carries liability, workers' compensation and contract works insurance. Many customers have come back for a second or third room.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Do you have a showroom?
  A: Yes. The showroom is at 26103 I-45, Suite 103A, in Spring (77380). It is open weekdays, and Saturday visits are by appointment.
- Q: Can we live at home during the remodel?
  A: Yes. Reviewers describe the crew covering rooms in plastic every day, keeping construction dust contained and cleaning up before they leave.
- Q: How long does a kitchen remodel take?
  A: It depends on the scope. One reviewer's kitchen took five days from start to finish, and another homeowner had two baths and a downstairs floor done in about two months.
- Q: Will I get a detailed estimate?
  A: Yes. One reviewer describes a line-by-line itemized estimate, and others say their job finished within budget and on the time estimate.
- Q: Is the work warranted?
  A: Yes. Exclusive Remodeling offers a homeowner's warranty and carries liability, workers' compensation and contract works insurance. Customers say Amine honors it.
- Q: Do you build patio covers and outdoor kitchens?
  A: Yes. Amine's team adds covered patios, outdoor living spaces and built-in outdoor kitchens in Spring and The Woodlands.
